terms.label: Renewal application has been submitted
terms.definition: The person has submitted (or is hereby submitting) a driving licence renewal application to the Transport Administration.

anchors.quote: Juhiloa uuendamiseks esitab isik Transpordiametile taotluse.

terms.label: Valid health certificate on record
terms.definition: The health information system records a currently valid health certificate for the person.

anchors.quote: Juhiluba uuendatakse, kui isikul on kehtiv tervisetõend.
anchors.note: Register-evidence term: the health information system is authoritative.

terms.label: State fee has been paid
terms.definition: The state treasury payment system records the renewal state fee as paid.

anchors.quote: Juhiloa uuendamise eest tasutakse riigilõiv enne taotluse läbivaatamist.
anchors.note: Register-evidence term: the payment ledger is authoritative.

terms.label: Right to drive is suspended or revoked
terms.definition: The traffic register records an active suspension or revocation of the person's right to drive.

anchors.quote: Juhiluba ei uuendata, kui isiku juhtimisõigus on peatatud või ära võetud.
anchors.note: Deny condition; the traffic register is authoritative.
